result.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate banks I,J,D,W, rank-two 2-row maps M,N, U=MX_I+a(X_W), V=NX_J+b(X_W), arbitrary H=H(X_I,X_D,X_W), and Q=2 U^T V+H, the output density satisfies ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(pi) det(MM^T)^(-1/4) sigma_min(N)^(-1).

partner_result_applied.application: sup_{T>0,y} D_T law(Q)(y) obeys the same 2 sqrt(pi) det(MM^T)^(-1/4) sigma_min(N)^(-1) bound.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-TWO-SIDED-CURVED-BICORE-RECEIVER-v1: pay the B07 concentrated two-sided physical core when both active grouped banks retain self-curvature, or product-preservingly orient/route it to an already-paid branch. Extra-spectrum splice remains separate.
